title: BTC turnover anomaly converted into joint range-volume expansion
summary: The 05:00 UTC Bybit spot turnover anomaly was followed by a completed 06:00 UTC joint range-and-volume expansion. Bybit spot printed a $196.30 range and 150.136441 BTC volume; versus the preceding 28 completed spot hours, robust z-scores were +2.78 for range and +3.24 for volume. Bybit linear ($201.70 range) and Twelve Data BTC/USD ($195.36 range) independently corroborated the price expansion. This supports a one-step precursor sequence but does not establish order-flow direction, causality, or persistent cross-market stress.
